rawCard.title: Afreet
rawCard.text: Afreet can host up to 3 MU of programs. Hosted programs use Afreet's hosting capacity instead of Runner MU.

rawCard.title: AI Boon
rawCard.text: 1: Break sentry subroutine. 1: +1 strength. At the start of each run, roll a die to determine AI Boon’s strength for that run.

rawCard.title: Baedeker’s Net Map
rawCard.text: 0: Base link 1. 1: +1 link. Use only one base link card for each trace attempt made against you.

rawCard.title: Bakdoor™
rawCard.text: 0: Base link 3. 2: +1 link. Use only one base link card for each trace attempt made against you.

rawCard.title: Bartmoss Memorial Icebreaker
rawCard.text:
1 credit: Break ice subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.
After passing each piece of ice, roll a die if you used Bartmoss Memorial Icebreaker to break any subroutines of that ice. On a 1, trash Bartmoss Memorial Icebreaker.

rawCard.title: Black Dahlia
rawCard.text:
2 credits: Break sentry subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rawCard.title: Blink
rawCard.text:
0 credits: Roll a die. On a 4, 5, or 6, break ice subroutine; otherwise, suffer that much Net damage.
Use this ability only once on each subroutine during each encounter with a piece of ice.

rawCard.title: Boardwalk
rawCard.text: Whenever you make a successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Boardwalk counter. At the start of each of your turns, every two Boardwalk counters require the Corp to show you, at random, a card stored in HQ. If the Corp does not have enough cards stored in HQ, the Corp shows you as many cards as it has. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

rawCard.title: Butcher Boy
rawCard.text: Whenever you make a successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Butcher Boy counter. Every two Butcher Boy counters gain you 1 credit at the start of each of your turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

rawCard.title: Cascade
rawCard.text: Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Cascade counter. Every two Cascade counters require the Corp to trash faceup one card stored in R&D at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

rawCard.title: Cloak
rawCard.text: Put 3 credits on Cloak when it is installed. Use these credits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for noisy icebreakers. If you use any credits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rawCard.title: Clown
rawCard.text: All ice is encountered with its strength reduced by 1.

rawCard.title: Cockroach
rawCard.text: Whenever you make a successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Cockroach counter. Two or more Cockroach counters cause all discards from HQ to become random. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

rawCard.title: Codecracker
rawCard.text:
0 credits: Break code gate subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.

rawCard.title: Codeslinger
rawCard.text: 1 credit: Break sentry subroutine.

rawCard.title: Cyfermaster™
rawCard.text:
2 credits: Break code gate subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.

rawCard.title: Deep Thought
rawCard.text: Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Thought counter. Three or more Thought counters allow you to look at the top card of R&D at the start of each of your turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

rawCard.title: Dogcatcher
rawCard.text:
1 credit: Break pit bull, hellhound, bloodhound, or watchdog subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.

rawCard.title: Dropp™
rawCard.text:
0 credits: Break all subroutines of a piece of ice, and end the run.
1 credit: +1 strength.

rawCard.title: Dupré
rawCard.text: 1: Break code gate subroutine. 2: +1 strength. Put a +1 strength counter on Dupré after each run during which it was used to break a subroutine. All strength counters on Dupré are lost if you use Dupré on a fort other than the one you last used it on.

rawCard.title: Dwarf
rawCard.text:
1 credit: Break wall subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.

rawCard.title: Emergency Self-Construct
rawCard.text: T: Prevent yourself from being flatlined, though you still lose all cards in your hand. Remove all brain damage. For the remainder of the game, you have only three actions per turn, instead of four; your hand size is reduced by 1; and all meat damage is automatically prevented.

rawCard.title: Evil Twin
rawCard.text:
3 credits: Break sentry subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.
Prevents up to 2 net and/or core damage total each turn.

rawCard.title: Expert Schedule Analyzer
rawCard.text: After you access cards from HQ, look at all cards stored in HQ.

rawCard.title: Fait Accompli
rawCard.text: Whenever you make a successful run on a subsidiary data fort, put a Fait counter in that fort. Every two Fait counters in a fort give +1 difficulty to all agendas installed inside that fort. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

rawCard.title: False Echo
rawCard.text: [2]: The Corp must rez as much ice as possible on a fort, beginning with the outermost ice and working in. Use this ability only after a successful run on that fort.

rawCard.title: Flak
rawCard.text: [1]: Break AP subroutine. [1]: +1 strength.

rawCard.title: Force Shield
rawCard.text: Prevents up to 2 net and/or core damage total each turn.

rawCard.title: Gremlins
rawCard.text: Whenever you make a successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Gremlin counter. Every two Gremlin counters decrease the Corp’s hand size by 1. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

rawCard.title: Grubb
rawCard.text:
1 credit: Break wall subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength for the remainder of this run.

rawCard.title: Hammer
rawCard.text: [1]: Break wall subroutine. [1]: +1 strength. Whenever you break a wall subroutine with Hammer, lose a total of [2] from stealth cards.

rawCard.title: I Spy
rawCard.text: [T]: Put a Spy counter in a data fort. A Spy counter exposes all cards installed inside or on a fort containing it. The Corp may remove a Spy counter by taking an action to pay 4. Use this ability only immediately after a successful run on that fort.

rawCard.title: Imp
rawCard.text: Imp can have up to 2 MU of programs installed in it. All icebreakers installed in this way have their strength reduced by 1. If IMP leaves play, trash all programs installed in it.

rawCard.title: Incubator
rawCard.text: Whenever you make a successful run, give the Corp an Incubate counter. Each Incubate counter necessitates a die roll at the start of each of your turns; on each 6, choose a Virus counter and exchange that counter for two counters of the same type. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

rawCard.title: Invisibility
rawCard.text: Put 1 from the bank on Invisibility when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use the bit, replace it at the start of your next turn.

rawCard.title: Jackhammer
rawCard.text:
0 credits: Break wall subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.
Whenever you break a wall subroutine with Jackhammer, lose 1 credit, if you can, from a stealth card.

rawCard.title: Japanese Water Torture
rawCard.text:
0: Break wall subroutine.
X: +X strength, and forgo your next X actions.

rawCard.title: Joan of Arc
rawCard.text:
[T]: Prevent one or more of your other installed programs from being trashed.
1 credit: Prevent one or more of your other installed programs from being trashed, and bring Joan of Arc into your hand.

rawCard.title: Krash
rawCard.text:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rawCard.title: Loony Goon
rawCard.text:
1 credit: Break sentry subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.

rawCard.title: Microtech AI Interface
rawCard.text: Whenever you are about to access cards from R&D, you may first choose to cut any number of cards from the top of R&D to the bottom of R&D.

rawCard.title: Mouse
rawCard.text: A: Expose a card installed inside a data fort.

rawCard.title: Mystery Box
rawCard.text: 0: Show the top five cards of your stack to the Corp. If any of those cards are programs, trash Mystery Box and then install one of those programs, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. Use this ability only during a run and only once each run.

rawCard.title: Netspace Inverter
rawCard.text: Reverse a fort’s ice cards so that the outermost piece of ice becomes the innermost piece of ice, and so forth. Use this ability only immediately after a successful run on that data fort.

rawCard.title: Newsgroup Filter
rawCard.text: A: Gain [2].

rawCard.title: Pattel’s Virus
rawCard.text: Whenever you make a successful run, put a Pattel counter on a piece of ice that had all its subroutines broken during that run. Each Pattel counter on a piece of ice reduces its strength by 1. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

rawCard.title: Pile Driver
rawCard.text: 3: Break up to four wall subroutines on a single piece of ice. 1: +1 strength. Whenever you use Pile Driver’s break-walls subroutine, lose a total of 3 from stealth cards.

rawCard.title: Poltergeist
rawCard.text: Put [2] on Poltergeist when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for trashing nodes. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rawCard.title: Pox
rawCard.text: Whenever you make a successful run, put a Pox counter in the fort that was run. Every two Pox counters in a fort require the Corp to pay 1, in addition to any other costs, to install a card inside or on that fort. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

rawCard.title: R&D-Protocol Files
rawCard.text: A: Make a run on R&D, but instead of accessing cards, look at the top five cards of R&D.

rawCard.title: Rabbit
rawCard.text: Ice that attempts to trace you has its trace limit reduced by 1.

rawCard.title: Raffles
rawCard.text:
1 credit: Break code gate subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rawCard.title: Ramming Piston
rawCard.text:
2 credits: Break wall subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.
Whenever you break a wall subroutine with Ramming Piston, lose a total of 2 credits from stealth cards.

rawCard.title: Raptor
rawCard.text:
2 credits: Break sentry subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.

rawCard.title: Reflector
rawCard.text: (0): Break stun, hellbolt, or knockout subroutine.

rawCard.title: Replicator
rawCard.text: 0: Break ice subroutine that traces. 1: +1 strength.

rawCard.title: Scatter Shot
rawCard.text: Put [2] from the bank on Scatter Shot when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for trashing upgrades. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rawCard.title: SeeYa
rawCard.text: A, 1: Expose an installed card.

rawCard.title: Self-Modifying Code
rawCard.text: T: Search your stack for a program and install that program, if you can. Shuffle your stack afterwards. Use this ability only during a run.

rawCard.title: Shaka
rawCard.text:
1 credit: Break sentry subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rawCard.title: Shield
rawCard.text: Prevents up to 2 Net damage each turn.

rawCard.title: Shredder Uplink Protocol
rawCard.text: A: Make a run on the Archives. If run is successful, do not access cards from the Archives; instead, treat run as a successful run on HQ.

rawCard.title: Signpost
rawCard.text: 1: +2 link. Use this ability only once during each trace attempt, and only after you and the Corp have revealed how much each of you spent.

rawCard.title: Skivviss
rawCard.text: Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Skivviss counter. Each Skivviss counter requires the Corp to draw one extra card at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

rawCard.title: Smarteye
rawCard.text: Once during each run, you may expose a piece of unrezzed ice as you approach it. You may then jack out before the Corp decides whether to rez the ice.

rawCard.title: Snowball
rawCard.text:
Snowball has +1 strength for each subroutine it has broken during a run, until the end of that run.
1 credit: Break sentry subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.

rawCard.title: Speed Trap
rawCard.text: 0: Jack out before an upgrade or node takes effect. Use this ability only immediately after the Corp has rezzed that upgrade or node.

rawCard.title: Startup Immolator
rawCard.text: T: Pay the rez cost of a piece of ice to trash that piece of ice. Use this ability only if you have just broken all the subroutines of that piece of ice.

rawCard.title: Succubus
rawCard.text: Succubus can host up to 3 MU of programs. If Succubus leaves play, trash all hosted programs.

rawCard.title: Tinweasel
rawCard.text: 0 credits: Break code gate subroutine.

rawCard.title: Vewy Vewy Quiet
rawCard.text: Put 2 from the bank on Vewy Vewy Quiet when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rawCard.title: Wild Card
rawCard.text:
0 credits: Break sentry subroutine.
3 credits: +1 strength.

rawCard.title: Wizard’s Book
rawCard.text:
0 credits: Break code gate subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rawCard.title: Worm
rawCard.text:
0 credits: Break wall subroutine.
3 credits: +1 strength.

rawCard.title: Zetatech Software Installer
rawCard.text: Put 2 bits on Software Installer when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for installing programs. You may use these bits to install a program overlying Software Installer itself. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rawCard.title: All-Nighter
rawCard.text: Make a run; whether or not that run is successful, you may then make another run.

rawCard.title: Anonymous Tip
rawCard.text: Derez a piece of black ice of your choice.

rawCard.title: Arasaka Owns You
rawCard.text: Do not play Arasaka Owns You as a normal action; instead, play it when you would suffer enough damage to flatline you. Prevent all of that damage, trash Arasaka Owns You, remove any brain damage you have suffered, and then refresh your hand to its maximum size. Gain 10 and remove all tags, at no cost. You forgo your next four actions, and you forfeit the next 3 agenda points you score.

rawCard.title: Bodyweight™ Synthetic Blood
rawCard.text: Draw five cards.

rawCard.title: Core Command: Jettison Ice
rawCard.text: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Pay the rez cost of a piece of rezzed ice to trash it.

rawCard.title: Custodial Position
rawCard.text: Make a run on R&D. If successful, access two additional cards from R&D.

rawCard.title: Deal with Militech
rawCard.text: Play only if you liberated any Research agendas this turn. Put a Militech counter on each of your icebreakers. A Militech counter gives the icebreaker it is on +1 strength.

rawCard.title: Desperate Competitor
rawCard.text: Play only if you liberated any Gray Ops agendas this turn. Score 1 agenda point.

rawCard.title: Edited Shipping Manifests
rawCard.text: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, and the Corp has any credits when you would access HQ, do not access cards from HQ; instead, the Corp loses 1 credit and gives you a tag, and you gain 10 credits.

rawCard.title: Executive Wiretaps
rawCard.text: Make a run on HQ. If successful, access two additional cards from HQ.

rawCard.title: Forged Activation Orders
rawCard.text: Choose a piece of ice. The Corp either rezzes that piece of ice or trashes it.

rawCard.title: Forgotten Backup Chip
rawCard.text: Search your trash for a program and bring it into your hand.

rawCard.title: Fortress Respecification
rawCard.text: Play only if you made a successful run this turn. Rearrange the ice installed on the last fort on which you made a successful run. This does not expose any concealed ice.

rawCard.title: Gideon’s Pawnshop
rawCard.text: Search your trash for a card and bring it into your hand.

rawCard.title: Hot Tip for WNS
rawCard.text: Score 1 agenda point if you liberated any Black Ops agendas this turn.

rawCard.title: Hunt Club BBS
rawCard.text: Expose up to three installed cards.

rawCard.title: Ice and Data’s Guide to the Net
rawCard.text: Expose the outermost ice of each data fort.

rawCard.title: If You Want It Done Right...
rawCard.text: Look through the top five cards of your stack. Bring one of those cards into your hand, and arrange the rest in any order you choose.

rawCard.title: Inside Job
rawCard.text: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

rawCard.title: Jack ’n’ Joe
rawCard.text: Draw three cards.

rawCard.title: Kilroy Was Here
rawCard.text: Make a run on R&D; you may trash, at no cost, any cards you access that were stored in R&D, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed.

rawCard.title: Livewire’s Contacts
rawCard.text: Gain 3.

rawCard.title: Lucidrine™ Booster Drug
rawCard.text: Make a run, and gain [9], which you may use only during that run. After that run is completed, suffer 1 brain damage; this damage cannot be prevented. Then, return to the bank any of the [9] not spent.

rawCard.title: Mantis, Fixer-at-Large
rawCard.text: Search your stack for a card, and bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

rawCard.title: misc.for-sale
rawCard.text: Trash any number of your installed cards. Gain [3] for each card trashed in this way.

rawCard.title: MIT West Tier
rawCard.text: Shuffle your hand, trash, and stack together, and then draw five cards. When you play MIT West Tier, remove it from the game instead of trashing it.

rawCard.title: Open-Ended® Mileage Program
rawCard.text: Remove a tag, at no cost. You may pay 1 when you play Open-Ended® Mileage Program to take it back into your hand instead of trashing it.

rawCard.title: Organ Donor
rawCard.text: Trash up to five cards from your hand. Gain [2] for each card trashed in this way.

rawCard.title: Playful AI
rawCard.text: Roll a die. On a 1, 2, or 3, gain that many bits, set aside that many dice to roll again, or choose some combination thereof. Repeat until you have rolled all the dice you set aside.

rawCard.title: Priority Wreck
rawCard.text: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, pay any number of bits to force the Corp to lose that many bits.

rawCard.title: Private LDL Access
rawCard.text: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, treat run as a successful run on R&D.

rawCard.title: Romp through HQ
rawCard.text: Make a run on HQ; you may trash, at no cost, any cards you access that were stored in HQ, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed.

rawCard.title: Score!
rawCard.text: Gain 9.

rawCard.title: Security Code WORM Chip
rawCard.text: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Trash a piece of unrezzed ice.

rawCard.title: Social Engineering
rawCard.text: Hide at least 2 from your pool in your hand; the Corp then guesses how many bits you hid. If the Corp guesses correctly, lose that many bits. Otherwise, choose a data fort and a piece of ice on that fort. Then make a run on that fort, during which you automatically pass that piece of ice.

rawCard.title: Stumble through Wilderspace
rawCard.text: Make a run. You have +9 link for every trace attempt made during that run.

rawCard.title: Synchronized Attack on HQ
rawCard.text: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. The Corp discards all cards. The Corp can retain cards by paying [2] for each card not discarded.

rawCard.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
rawCard.text: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

rawCard.title: Terrorist Reprisal
rawCard.text: Play only if the Corp scored any Black Ops agendas during its last turn. The Corp discards five cards at random.

rawCard.title: Total Genetic Retrofit
rawCard.text: Remove all tags, at no cost, and automatically avoid receiving your next tag.

rawCard.title: Valu-Pak Software Bundle
rawCard.text: Gain up to five consecutive actions, which you may use only to install programs, and gain [1]. If you do not spend the bit during these actions, return it to the bank afterwards.

rawCard.title: Weather-to-Finance Pipe
rawCard.text: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, the Corp loses 4 credits.

rawCard.title: Arasaka Portable Prototype
rawCard.text: Provides +3 MU. Installing Arasaka Portable Prototype costs 1 agenda point, in addition to the normal cost. Put [3] from the bank on Arasaka Portable Prototype when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

rawCard.title: “Armadillo” Armored Road Home
rawCard.text: Put [2] from the bank on Armored Road Home when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for removing tags. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn. [T]: Prevent up to 3 meat damage.

rawCard.title: Armored Fridge
rawCard.text:
Put seven Ablative counters on Armored Fridge when it is installed. When the last Ablative counter has been removed, trash Armored Fridge.
Ablative counter: Prevent 1 meat damage.

rawCard.title: Artemis 2020
rawCard.text: Provides +2 MU. Put [2] from the bank on Artemis 2020 when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

rawCard.title: Bodyweight™ Data Crèche
rawCard.text: Provides +1 MU. Once per turn, right after making a successful run, you can choose to make another run without taking an action to do so. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

rawCard.title: Corolla Speed Chip
rawCard.text: Put [1] from the bank on Corolla Speed Chip when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using killers during runs. If you use the bit, replace it at the start of your next turn.

rawCard.title: Dermatech Bodyplating
rawCard.text: Prevents 1 meat damage each turn.

rawCard.title: “Drifter” Mobile Environment
rawCard.text: Put [2] from the bank on Mobile Environment when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for removing tags. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rawCard.title: Full Body Conversion
rawCard.text: Prevents all meat damage. For each 1 credit the Corp pays when meat damage is done, 1 meat damage is not prevented.

rawCard.title: “Green Knight” Surge Buffers
rawCard.text: Prevents 1 net damage each turn.

rawCard.title: HQ Interface
rawCard.text: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

rawCard.title: Lifesaver™ Nanosurgeons
rawCard.text:
A: Draw two cards. Use this ability only if you were damaged during any of your last three actions.
[T]: Prevent 1 brain damage.

rawCard.title: Microtech Backup Drive
rawCard.text:
Whenever one or more installed programs are being sent to the trash at the same time, you may instead choose to put any or all of the programs on top of Microtech Backup Drive in any order you choose. If Backup Drive is removed from play, trash any cards on it.
A: Bring the top card on Backup Drive into your hand.

rawCard.title: Microtech ’Trode Set
rawCard.text: Pay [1], in addition to the normal cost, to break each ice subroutine. Ignore all AP subroutines except those that trace, or that do Net damage. Prevents all but 1 Net damage from each AP subroutine you do not break.

rawCard.title: Militech MRAM Chip
rawCard.text: Hand size +3.

rawCard.title: MRAM Chip
rawCard.text: Hand size +2.

rawCard.title: Nasuko Cycle
rawCard.text: 3 credits: Avoid receiving a tag.

rawCard.title: Pandora’s Deck
rawCard.text: Provides +2 MU. Put [3] from the bank on Pandora’s Deck when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for increasing your link. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

rawCard.title: Parraline 5750
rawCard.text: Provides +1 MU. Put [1] from the bank on Parraline 5750 when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs. If you use the bit, replace it at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

rawCard.title: PK-6089a
rawCard.text: Provides +1 MU. Put [3] from the bank on PK-6089a when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for increasing your link. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

rawCard.title: R&D Interface
rawCard.text: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

rawCard.title: Raven Microcyb Eagle
rawCard.text: Provides +1 MU. Prevents 1 Net damage each turn. Put [1] from the bank on Microcyb Eagle when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

rawCard.title: Record Reconstructor
rawCard.text: A: Make a run on the Archives. If run is successful, do not access cards from the Archives; instead, shuffle the face-up pile of the Archives and then put the top two cards from that pile on R&D.

rawCard.title: Techtronica™ Utility Suit
rawCard.text: Provides +1 MU. Prevents 1 meat damage each turn. Put 5 credits on Techtronica Utility Suit when it is installed. Use these credits only to pay for increasing your link. If you use any of these credits, replace them at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

rawCard.title: Tycho Mem Chip
rawCard.text: Provides +3 MU.

rawCard.title: WuTech Mem Chip
rawCard.text: Provides +1 MU.

rawCard.title: Zetatech Mem Chip
rawCard.text: Provides +2 MU.

rawCard.title: ZZ22 Speed Chip
rawCard.text: Put [2] from the bank on ZZ22 Speed Chip when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using killers during runs. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rawCard.title: Access through Alpha
rawCard.text: [1]: Base link 9. Use only one base link card for each trace attempt made against you.

rawCard.title: Access to Arasaka
rawCard.text: [2]: Base link 4. [2]: +1 link. Use only one base link card for each trace attempt made against you.

rawCard.title: Access to Kiribati
rawCard.text: [1]: Base link 1. [1]: +1 link. Use only one base link card for each trace attempt made against you.

rawCard.title: Aujourd’Oui
rawCard.text: A: Look at the top five cards of your stack. You may bring any program cards among them into your hand. Pay [1] for each card taken in this way, and show those cards to the Corp. Shuffle your stack.

rawCard.title: Back Door to Hilliard
rawCard.text: [0]: Base link 2. [3]: +1 link. Use only one base link card for each trace attempt made against you.

rawCard.title: Back Door to Orbital Air
rawCard.text: [1]: Base link 2. [2]: +1 link. Use only one base link card for each trace attempt made against you.

rawCard.title: Code Viral Cache
rawCard.text: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. If the Corp forgoes actions to lose Virus counters, two counters of your choice are not removed. The Corp may trash Code Viral Cache by taking an action to pay 5.

rawCard.title: Corporate Ally
